items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Now if this would have been Joe Venuti --

ctx.x: It didn't sound to me like they had a cello or --
No, no, no, just probably a couple of violins then a little something that somebody wrote out for them to improvise. Now if this would have been Joe Venuti --

Okay, but if there was some balance, if there was some kind of, you know, something from the lower register in there with those other fiddles then that might have been a different proposition, but it sounds very thin.
